admission: Manually verify publisher, document title/date, affected products, old/new formulas, interval units and any precise sampling/weight rule. Missing, ambiguous or out-of-scope clauses remain unknown; a formula alone does not qualify raw weights, remaining-sample support, own settlement entitlement or profitable hedging. Search snippets and article links are not admitted facts.
failure_policy: Terminal source failure remains retained. No retry, locale, mirror, follow-up link, economic access, account/order, training or source-law qualification follows this one-use plan.
question: What exact effective formula, interval scaling, premium/mark computation or observation timing does this distinct publisher notice establish for USD-M funding? Does it supply raw sample weights/support sufficient for causal remaining-rate bounds?
selection: Exact official announcement URL discovered by search; snippets are URL discovery only. Earlier FAQ citation has no retained source body and is not recaptured.
source_inventory_scope: Published Markdown/JSON except archive, plus topic-selected private contract/result/journal metadata only; excluded raw/protected/partial/v7/tool directories before reading. No universal novelty claim.
